image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a female or non-breeding male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched on a diagonal tree branch. The bird has brownish-grey upperparts with darker streaking, a buff-orange wash on the breast and flanks, and a pale belly. It features a short, conical bill that appears greyish-yellow, dark round eyes, and wings with visible white wing bars. The background consists of out-of-focus blue sky and bare tree branches.
